text: {"established":["The first candidate received a public_pass receipt for 20 checks, and the second received a public_pass receipt for 40 checks.","The third candidate, values [-33,-183,437,59,45,-325], received a public_mismatch on the released check “balance-0.” No replacement answer was supplied."],"retained_observations":["The task specifies six accounts, opening balances [0,0,0,0,0,0], and output values as balances for accounts 0 through 5; order and files must be empty.","Earlier packets remain relevant. For each transaction, use the largest revision, breaking revision ties by largest sequence. A revision replaces the whole transaction; it is not an additional transfer. Ignore the selected transaction if void=true. Otherwise subtract its amount from the source and add it to the destination. Late packets can revise old transactions, and balances are recomputed at every stage.","The first two candidate notes describe using highest revisions and ignoring void transactions; their public receipts passed their respective released checks. The third candidate used the same described approach but failed a released check. That failure does not establish that the method itself is invalid."],"uncertainties":["The mismatch receipt does not identify why balance-0 failed or provide corrected balances.","The trial notes are unverified descriptions of the candidates’ calculations; the receipts do not independently establish their calculation method."]}
